Provides a complete quote-aware fix with a reusable predicate and well-focused regressions covering double quotes, backticks, nesting, and the adapted response body.

Consistently distinguishes structural braces throughout parsing and dispensing, with focused parser and HTTP adaptation regressions.

Fixes the reported case with useful end-to-end and heredoc coverage, but still rejects quoted addresses ending in an opening brace and retains the quoted-{} line-boundary bug.
Implements the complete quote-aware structural fix with focused shared helpers, although its added tests cover only basic parser behavior rather than dispensing or adaptation.

Correctly propagates branch slugs through nested sections, regular pages, and generated terms while preserving URL/permalink precedence, with focused multilingual integration coverage.

Enables basic early returns and removes the old wrapper, but lacks template-local return boundaries, drops pipeline inputs when evaluating return commands, and conflates bare and valued returns.

Basic early returns work, but template boundaries swallow valued returns, bare partial returns discard rendered output, invalid return pipelines are accepted, and unrelated module-test skips broaden the patch.
